namespace shapes {

class Rectangle {
public:
    Rectangle(int w, int h) : width_(w), height_(h) {
        if (w < 0 || h < 0) {
            width_ = 0;
            height_ = 0;
        }
    }

    int area() const {
        return width_ * height_;
    }

    bool contains(int x, int y) const {
        if (x >= 0 && x < width_) {
            if (y >= 0 && y < height_) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    Rectangle operator+(const Rectangle& other) const {
        return Rectangle(width_ + other.width_, height_ + other.height_);
    }

private:
    int width_;
    int height_;
};

namespace nested {

class Circle {
public:
    double area() const {
        return radius_ > 0 ? 3.14159 * radius_ * radius_ : 0.0;
    }

private:
    double radius_ = 0.0;
};

}  // namespace nested

}  // namespace shapes

class OuterOnly {
public:
    int pick(int a, int b, int c) {
        switch (a) {
            case 1: return b;
            case 2: return c;
            default: return a;
        }
    }
};
